2608.28360.title: Propagating construction-time knowledge quality into medical question answering: A framework grounded in clinical guidelines
2608.28360.paper_summary: Large language models have facilitated knowledge graph (KG) construction from clinical guidelines, but extracted triples vary in structural validity and evidential support. Meanwhile, graph-augmented question answering (QA) systems typically optimize query relevance during retrieval, with limited reuse of quality information produced during KG construction. This creates a disconnect between construction-time quality control and inference-time evidence use. We investigate whether construction-time triple quality can serve as a persistent signal for downstream evidence selection and presentation. We propose a quality-aware framework that models structural conformance (SchemaConf) and evidential support (EvidScore) as complementary dimensions and fuses them into a per-triple quality signal, Q(t). Rather than using quality solely for filtering, the framework retains Q(t) and derived quality tiers as graph attributes and propagates them into quality-weighted subgraph retrieval and tier-conditioned evidence prompting, while preserving passage-level provenance. Experiments on Chinese diabetes clinical guidelines show that the utility of the quality signal is distribution dependent. Under cross-version and cross-model shift, the fused Q(t) provides stronger triple-quality discrimination than either component alone (AUC 0.748 vs. 0.703 for EvidScore and 0.645 for SchemaConf). In guideline-grounded QA, propagating construction-time quality reduces required-knowledge omission from 16.3% to 5.3% and conflicting outputs from 16.3% to 2.7%, with an evidence-grounded precision of 81.6% and near-zero invalid citations. Blinded clinician ratings favor the full framework over no retrieval (4.68 vs. 4.21 on a five-point scale) and approach the oracle condition (4.80), while cross-generator experiments show consistent trends.
2608.28360.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型促進了從臨床指導中構建知識圖譜（KG），但提取的三元組在結構有效性和證據支持方面存在差異。<lb/>同時，增強圖形的問題回答（QA）系統通常在檢索過程中優化查詢相關性，而對於在KG構建過程中產生的優質信息的重用則有限。<lb/>這造成了構建時質量控制與推理時證據使用之間的脫節。<lb/>我們研究構建時的三元組質量是否可以作為下游證據選擇和呈現的持久信號。<lb/>我們提出了一個質量感知框架，將結構一致性（SchemaConf）和證據支持（EvidScore）建模為互補維度，並將它們融合為每個三元組的質量信號Q(t)。<lb/>該框架不僅僅將質量用於過濾，而是保留Q(t)和派生質量層級作為圖形屬性，並將它們傳播到質量加權的子圖檢索和層級條件的證據提示中，同時保留段落級的來源信息。<lb/>對中國糖尿病臨床指導的實驗表明，質量信號的效用依賴於分佈。<lb/>在跨版本和跨模型轉變下，融合的Q(t)提供了比任何單一組件更強的三元組質量區分（AUC 0.748對比EvidScore的0.703和SchemaConf的0.645）。<lb/>在以指導為基礎的QA中，傳播構建時的質量將所需知識的遺漏從16.3%減少到5.3%，衝突輸出從16.3%減少到2.7%，證據基礎的精確度為81.6%，幾乎沒有無效引用。<lb/>盲評的臨床醫生評分更青睞完整框架而非無檢索（在五分制上為4.68對比4.21），並接近神諭條件（4.80），而跨生成器的實驗顯示出一致的趨勢。
